# Data Center Training

> Data Center Training (datacentertraining.us) is a specialty training division of HAZWOPER-OSHA Training, LLC, an IACET-accredited provider of professional data center and safety compliance training. We offer 44 online courses (250 hours total) covering data center design, operations, power, cooling, security, and facilities management, self-paced with a certificate on completion.

Courses are sold individually or as a complete catalog bundle for $1,999.99. Programs are grouped into Comprehensive Programs (12-18 hrs, full-discipline curriculum) and Modular Specializations (1-8 hrs, focused hands-on skills).

## Key Pages

- [Homepage](https://datacentertraining.us/): Full course catalog, role-based learning tracks, bundles, certifications, and FAQ.
- [Course Catalog](https://datacentertraining.us/#courses): All 44 courses with duration, price, and standards alignment (ANSI/TIA-942, NFPA 70E, Uptime Institute Tier Framework, ASHRAE, SOC 2/ISO 27001, and more).
- [Sitemap](https://datacentertraining.us/sitemap.xml): Complete list of course pages.
- [llms-full.txt](https://datacentertraining.us/llms-full.txt): Full course catalog and details in Markdown.
